messages:
alex: quick update — pushing kernel v2.3.1 integration into canary this morning. main goals: stabilize continuous-batching handshake, KV cache prefetch thresholds, and ensure no p95 latency regressions. rolling 10% of serving nodes now.
maya: thanks. which clusters are in the 10% canary?
ajax: (typo) alex: oops, meant alex — canary is us-west-2-g and eu-west-1-b pools, traffic routed to dedicated hotpath lane.
jong: flagged dependency: eng-infra fixed the shared-alloc race in #5823 but it still needs the DB migration in infra-ops. do we have that scheduled?
pm-ash: infra-ops scheduled the migration at 22:00 UTC today. if canary passes before that we could accelerate, otherwise hold full rollout until after migration.
alex: noted. quick telemetry from first 15m: p50 tokens/second +3.2%, p50 latency -12ms, p95 latency +1.1ms (noise). KV hit rate up ~4%. overall cost/unit down ~2%.
sre-bot: canary-run:1745502100 status=healthy checks=[cpu<85%,oom=0,error-rate<0.1%], alert=none
liz: great. any sign of cache thrash with longer sequences? last test showed an eviction spike at seq>2k.
alex: checked eviction logs — saw 3 small spikes at ~14:10 UTC corresponding to a burst of long-seq requests from integration-tests. not present in normal traffic. config used: `kv.prefetch_window=256`, `kv.max_entries=20000`
jong: can we try `kv.prefetch_window=512` in next canary shard? that helped in local sim. tradeoff is memory.
maya: we should gate on OOM metrics — if prefetch* increase causes memory pressure, revert. add automated rollbacks for >80% GPU mem.
alex: agreed. I'll queue a canary variant with prefetch_window=512 on 3 instances and run for 30m. PR is rdx/runtime#5891 — needs one more reviewer. @liz can you take a look?
liz: on it, will review after standup.
pm-ash: two questions — 1) if p95 reg is persistent after prefetch change, what's plan B? 2) are there customer-facing degradations expected?
ajong: plan B is to enable KV soft-eviction + per-request sequence cap (default 1024) for heavy tails. that should bound latency while we iterate. customer impact: none for normal-length requests, heavy tails might see truncated context until we roll full fix.
alex: adding to runbook: `if p95 > baseline +5% for 10m -> rollback to v2.3.0 and disable prefetch bump`
devex-zoe: can we get a short blurb for the docs/notes so SDK teams know about the soft-eviction flag? customers might notice partial outputs.
alex: will draft one-line note: "temporary soft-eviction enabled during kernel rollout — long-context requests may be truncated; set X-Force-Full-KV header to opt-out (not recommended)."
sre-bot: deploy-note: rdx/runtime#5891 deployed to canary-variant-2 at 1745502400
maya: also pinging eng-platform — routing fallback policy needs to prefer regional warm nodes if a canary spike hits. @jong can you open ticket?
jong: opened ticket PLATFORM-1129 with steps and owners. linked in PR.
liz: quick CR comment: the codepath in batching.c has a subtle lock-order flip. left an inline comment but it's small. Alex, could you address before promoting?
alex: yep will address. ETA 2h. if fixed, we can promote to 30% after infra migration.
pm-ash: sounds good. keep stakeholders posted in this thread. thanks team :thumbsup:
devex-zoe: one more ask — can someone paste the smoke-check command we use for canary metrics into this thread? makes it easier for on-call to re-run.
alex: smoke command:```bash
rdx-canary-check --cluster us-west-2-g --metric p95_latency,p50_latency,kv_hit_rate --window 15m
```
sre-bot: smoke-check result cached at 1745503000 -> p50:-12ms p95:+1.1% kv_hit:+4%
maya: perfect. keeping this thread as the source of truth for the next 2h. I'll update if infra migration timing changes.
pm-ash: FYI — customer success onboarded a high-volume trial starting 03/12 UTC; we'll map them off canary pool during trial to avoid noise.
alex: thanks. I'll annotate the rollout plan and set the rollback timer. last note: tagging this thread with milestone: kernel-integration-2025-q1.
jong: thanks all. will monitor PLATFORM-1129 and the PR comments.
liz: reviewing now.
alex: closing checkpoints here for now — will post final pass or rollback decision before 1745503780.
